results.question: What is our overall gross profit margin?
results.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * ol.quantity) AS numeric), 2) AS gross_profit, ROUND(CAST(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1) AS numeric), 2) AS total_revenue_ex_gst, ROUND(CAST(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1 - v.cost * ol.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM((ol.unit_price * ol.quantity - ol.line_discount) / 1.1), 0) * 100 AS numeric), 2) AS gross_profit_margin_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_lines ol ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided' AND v.cost IS NOT NULL
results.answer: Your overall gross profit margin is 58.32%, based on a total gross profit of $1,584,502.69 from $2,716,823.41 in revenue (ex-GST). This calculation includes all non-voided orders but excludes any product variants that were missing cost data.

results.question: What is the best-selling product in each product type?
results.sql:
WITH ranked_products AS ( 
  SELECT 
    lower(p.product_type) AS product_type,
    p.title AS product_title,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lower(p.product_type) ORDER BY SUM(ol.quantity) DESC) as rn
  FROM order_lines ol
  JOIN orders o ON ol.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN variants v ON ol.variant_id = v.variant_id
  JOIN products p ON v.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.financial_status <> 'voided'
  GROUP BY lower(p.product_type), p.title
)
SELECT product_type, product_title, total_units_sold
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY product_type;
results.answer: Your best-selling products by category are the Straw Hat for accessories (3,619 units), Shirt Dress for dresses (1,492 units), Merino Crew Jumper for knitwear (526 units), and Wool Coat for outerwear (828 units). Additionally, High-Rise Jeans lead pants (1,295 units), Linen Wrap Skirt leads skirts (1,804 units), One-Piece Swimsuit leads swimwear (4,043 units), and Ribbed Tank leads tops (1,395 units). These totals include all non-voided orders and do not factor in returns or cancellations.
results.assumptions: Removed accidental semicolons from the CTE definition to fix the syntax error. Best-selling is measured by total units sold across all non-voided orders.
